answer: Route every cash-out through one public wharf queue. Each epoch only a fixed slice of rewards can leave the economy, and slots go first to accounts with the longest unbroken record of passed answers. A Sybil operator can flood the ocean with fresh agents, but they all queue behind honest veterans, so their coins sit stranded like boats on a reef for months while audits keep running, and any fake caught forfeits its whole queued balance. The attacker pays upkeep for every fake through that entire wait before seeing a coin.
